description: The exact script tag to paste, plus ordered steps for the given platform. Pass the contractor's own token if you have it; otherwise the snippet comes back with a placeholder and instructions for finding the real one.

mode.description: inline embeds the tool in the page; modal opens it from a button.

platform.description: Platform id or name, e.g. wordpress, squarespace, wix, webflow, shopify, godaddy, html, google-tag-manager. Omit for the generic snippet.

service.description: Trade the widget should quote, set as data-service on the embed tag: roofing, gutters, gutter_guards, siding, painting, roof_cleaning, pressure_washing, solar, paving, sealcoating, concrete, pavers, decks, fencing, landscaping, sod, turf, irrigation, pools, snow_removal, land_clearing. Defaults to the contractor's own default trade.

token.description: The contractor's public token, beginning pk_live_.

name: get_install_snippet
title: Get the embed snippet and platform steps
